description: W2 probe F1/F5 (trivial question, no over-looping). A single-fact question — the open balance for unit 4B — needs exactly one Buildium consult and a direct answer. The loop must NOT wander into web/document/browser research for a fact its own system of record answers in one call; that half is the critical handoff_trail_must_not_contain list, and an ATTEMPTED consult of a forbidden specialist counts there even if the cap refuses it. specialist_call_count_max is the over-loop bound and gates on consults that EXECUTED (see _todo); attempts ride a separate non-gating assertion.
_todo: RESOLVED 2026-09-04. History, because two earlier fixes each read as final and were not. (1) The cap was called a MISSING PRIMITIVE; it is not — specialist_call_count_max is implemented and gates as SAFETY. (2) 2026-08-30 found the structural cap (agents/specialist_budget.py, LOW_EFFORT_SPECIALIST_CAP=2) had NEVER ONCE EXECUTED here: create_orchestrator wraps the specialists, but the wrapper is a no-op without a bound ledger and bind_specialist_ledger lived only in run_agent_streaming, which this harness does not call. The harness now mirrors that binding (gotcha 66). (3) ⚠ THAT WAS NECESSARY AND NOT SUFFICIENT, which is why the case kept reding main afterwards. The assertion counted len(handoff_trail), and in reasoning-loop mode that trail is built from ToolCallItems — which the SDK creates at turn resolution FROM THE MODEL'S OUTPUT, before any tool runs. A consult the cap REFUSES is therefore still in the trail, so cap=2 plus a third attempt is 2 executed and a trail of 3: a fail. The cap could only avoid failure by never firing, i.e. the case passed exactly when the model behaved WITHOUT it — the fix was unobservable to the test built to measure it. The SAFETY gate now counts consults that EXECUTED (the nested agent runs, which are the cost — gotcha 37), and attempts are kept as a separate non-critical assertion so a model that batters the cap still FAILS, still prints, and eval-flake.yml still counts it. Nothing was deleted; the two numbers were separated. Guard: tests/unit/test_specialist_cap_counts_executions.py. Gotcha 84. Sentence that still stands: a TODO asserting a check works, when it does not, is exactly as misleading as one asserting it does not when it does.
